title: The one morning step I never skip
why: It opens with a bold claim, shows a real and easy routine in one idea per scene, and ends with one clear ask.
hooks: This is the one step I never skip in my morning routine.
Real talk: my morning skincare is ridiculously simple.
full_script:
This is the one step I never skip in my morning routine.

Okay, real morning. Face washed, no filter, still half asleep.

Next, my Glow Serum. I smooth it over my face with clean fingertips.

Then moisturizer, and that's it. Simple, and my skin feels ready for the day.

Easy enough that I actually stick with it every morning.

If you want a simple morning routine, try the Glow Serum from Glow Lab. Link's right here.
